metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Herniated Disc Pain in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that can give both quick and long-lasting relief for pains caused by a lumbar herniated disc.

These exercises are going to help take pressure off bulging and herniated discs (and pinched nerves), which may give instant relief for lower back pain and sciatica. 

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give relief within seconds.

Watch now and relieve herniated disc pain (and sciatica) at home!
